Source: @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.sects.JournalEntry.6868ee8c357f4b73]{Sabbat} Guide, @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.rules-reference-st.JournalEntry.yEPxZHRgMGIQ2JJQ]{Derangements}

You have tremendous difficulty controlling your anger and frustration. When confronted with stressful situations, you often lose control, lashing out at those unfortunate enough to cross your path, whether friend or foe. The bloodlust and violence of the @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.sects.JournalEntry.6868ee8c357f4b73]{Sabbat} suits you well - indeed, the sect seems to breed this kind of madness.

Trigger/Effect: You must win two Simple Tests to avoid frenzy.
